description: Reg. § 1.469-2T(d)(2)(v): a deduction treated as nonpassive under § 469(g) is not a passive activity deduction, so a significant participation activity sold entirely at an overall loss stays out of the significant participation test. Activity A (significant participation) earns $10,000; activity B (significant participation) is sold entirely with a $20,000 loss, all allowed; the test weighs A alone, so A's $10,000 is nonpassive and cannot absorb the $8,000 loss of passive business C — all $8,000 is carried over.
